articles.summary: Kinsale Capital Group, Inc. (NYSE: KNSL) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.25 per share of common stock. This dividend is payable on December 14, 2026 to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 30, 2026. About Kinsale Capital Group, Inc. Kinsale Capital Group, Inc. is a specialty insurance group headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, focusing on the excess and surplus lines market. Kinsale Capital Group, Inc. Bryan P. Petrucelli Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer 804-289-1272 ir@kinsalecapitalgroup.com Source: Kinsale Capital Group, Inc.
